subtasks.objective: Eliminate the legacy POS alert XSS sink by replacing Alert.js innerHTML interpolation of title, message, and buttonText with safe DOM construction using textContent/createElement, while preserving the existing modal structure and behavior.
subtasks.acceptance: urypos/src/stores/Alert.js no longer assigns untrusted alert values through innerHTML; title, message, and button text are rendered as text nodes/textContent; the documented invoiceData.js error callers that pass e?.title and err.message continue to display alerts without executing embedded markup or scripts; the legacy POS app builds or the changed files pass an equivalent syntax check.
